simple.meaning: שׂוּחַ (sûwach) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to muse pensively.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Genesis, beginning at Genesis 24:63. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שׂוּחַ (H7742) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שׂוּחַ (sûwach) / H7742 is traced through Genesis 24:63 with source-language evidence and verse context.
